name: search_mail
summary: Search Mail.app's indexed content via Spotlight (subjects, senders, body text). See docs/issues/note-applescript-mail-search-deferred.md for known precision gaps (very new mail, recently-migrated archives, Junk/Spam, account-exact scoping).

params.name: query
params.description: Free-text term (subject, sender, or body). Must not begin with '-' (safety guard, else Spotlight treats it as an option).

name: send_mail
summary: Compose and SEND a real email via Mail.app. Irreversible: there is no undo for a sent email.

params.name: attachments
params.description: Path(s) of existing file(s) to attach (leading ~ ok). If you only know roughly where a file is (e.g. "in Downloads"), locate it with the filesystem tool first, then pass the resolved path here.
